case.summary: This case was triggered by an analyst request monitoring a device profile used across 18 cards in November and December. The graph analysis revealed that the device profile was linked to intensive multi-card activity, shared with 21 other cards, and connected to 10 confirmed closed fraud cases. The verdict is fraud due to high memory-model scores, a new device status, and historical connections to known fraud rings. Next steps include blocking the card (pending approval), monitoring connected cards, and filing a regulatory report (pending approval).
